A pattern uses $19$, $26$, $33$ and $40$ matches for shapes $1$, $2$, $3$ and $4$.
Which equation gives the number of matches $y$ in shape $x$?

options.why: Used shape $1$'s value $19$ as the constant instead of working back one step ($19 - 7 = 12$).
